title.en: Take a Slice of the Data

brief.zh: 换一换起点、终点或数组列，对照完整数据和切片结果。
brief.en: Change the start, stop, or array column and compare the slice with the full input.

concept.zh: NumPy 的 a[start:stop] 包含 start，遇到 stop 就停。
concept.en: NumPy’s a[start:stop] starts at start and stops before stop.

hints.zh: 先运行 0 到 3，再把终点改为 4，观察哪一项加入了结果。
hints.en: Run from 0 to 3, then change the stop to 4 and see which value appears.

prompt.zh: 调整起点和终点，尝试用同样的切片查看两列。
prompt.en: Adjust the start and stop, then try the same slice on both columns.
